div.div:
Step 4: Each CPU sends the portion of its segments to the corresponding CPU - as given
by the samples - and sorts the data it receives. As the samples split the range of values
in the order of the CPUs' ranks, the final data is sorted across all CPUs.

div.div:
All cpus have now the [4,10,30] samples. In practice this means that:
- cpu 0 will receive all data below 4
- cpu 1 will receive all data from 4 up to 10 (excluded)
- cpu 2 will receive all data from 10 up to 30
